subject: kernel 0087 scoped cache maintenance (host-only, not applied)
body: Prepared gpu/build/kernel-p1-20261026/0087-scope-cache-maintenance-to-job-buffers.patch sha256 b3832a44945f71c2c82707866cd26b1ebb24fdb4fc5edfdb905df28eadf35a30 (+candidate-gpu-source-0087.patch 17fae36f..., tests-0087-bridge-list-closure.patch 58075f50..., README-0087.md).
